title: ‘GoStudy’, India’s Top Study Abroad Consultancy awarded “Great Place to Work” and “Times Education Icon”
description:
GoStudy™ is now a Great Place to Work-Certified™ organization, recognized worldwide by employees and employers alike, and is considered the 'Gold Standard' in identifying and recognizing Great Workplace Cultures. GoStudy has created a Great Place to Work FOR ALL their employees by excelling on the 5 dimensions of a High-Trust, High-Performance Culture™ – Credibility, Respect, Fairness, Pride, and Camaraderie.
Recently, GoStudy, a leader in overseas education consulting, launched their new operational HQ in Chennai to help Indian students realize their overseas education dream. GoStudy already has a strong presence across India with offices in Chennai, Delhi, Mumbai, Pune, Bangalore, Cochin, Trivandrum, and Coimbatore, leading the path with a well-established network of physical presence across India in the international education industry. As an 'Official University Partner' for all Universities, GoStudy provides free personalized Admission & Scholarship guidance by Certified Education Experts.
GoStudy hosted a press conference to share the joy of receiving the Great Place to Work award, and Times Education Icon presented by Times Group. During the event, the Managing Director of GoStudy Mrs. Lakshmi Prabha, spoke about their upcoming plans for the future, including expanding the brand into Mangalore, Mysore, Vizag, Jaipur, Lucknow, Guntur, Kozhikode, Kohlapur, etc., to serve more students in tier 2 cities. Despite the challenging market, GoStudy aims to hire approximately 250 talented professionals and freshers seeking promising opportunities. “We firmly believe that adding proactive talent will further propel our company's growth.” she said.
After Covid, more and more students are planning to study abroad. Recent trends show steady growth in Indian Students' applications to study abroad. According to the Ministry of external affairs, as of 2022, 13 Lakh Indian Students are studying abroad, and India will eventually take over the number of International Students from China. While engineering remains a popular course, there is a rising trend towards specialised courses in niche study areas.
GoStudy's new operational HQ boasts a team of highly qualified professional consultants with extensive experience in overseas education. They provide personalized guidance and support to students in their journey toward their desired international higher education destination. GoStudy is sure to consolidate and strengthen its presence in India after its consistent achievements over the years. With a successful track record of placing over 10,000 students in countries like the USA, Canada, UK, Australia, New Zealand, Ireland, France, and other European countries, We have been lauded with appreciation from our students and their parents for the past 10+ years. A strong digital presence and an ever-ready response to enquiries through certified consultants have worked out perfectly for GoStudy and are the secret behind our success.
Strategies for GoStudy:
GoStudy's strategies revolve around offering personalized attention, engaging SOP and LORs, a streamlined application process, assistance with education loans and accommodation, and comprehensive knowledge of study destinations, universities, and sector scopes. Consultants undergo regular training to stay updated on the latest information regarding courses, universities, and visa requirements. With a remarkable 100% visa success rate, GoStudy is well-positioned to build on its success.
"We are looking forward to this great leap as we are sure of what we are doing with a young, dynamic team of consultants, ready to assist students and to make a mark in the industry," concluded Lakshmi Prabha.

title: The Importance of Physical Security Solutions in the Digital World
description:
In an era where digital threats dominate the headlines, there is significant focus on cybersecurity. As India advances with groundbreaking digital innovations, there is a parallel rise in the need for robust physical security measures. While cybersecurity is crucial for protecting data and digital assets, it is also a reality that a lot of our wealth such as- gold, cash, jewellery, crucial documents are physical in nature. Hence, there is a need to move from traditional storage solutions to more high-quality physical security solutions—such as safes, vaults, and high-security locks.
Rising Demand for Physical Security Solutions
As industries like banking, finance, and data centers manage critical infrastructure, the potential consequences of physical breaches can be severe. Traditional passive physical security products, such as vaults and safes, offer robust protection but lack real-time visibility and monitoring capabilities. These methods do not provide digital footprints for access control, real-time monitoring thereby making it challenging to detect and neutralize threats promptly.
In contrast, active physical security solutions integrate advanced monitoring systems and access control technologies, enabling better threat detection and response. By adopting active high security electronic locking mechanism equipped with biometric access control features, 24 by 7 connectivity, duress notifications industries can achieve an enhanced level of security ecosystem through continuous monitoring, real-time alerts, and comprehensive access management.
Integrating Digital and Physical Security Solutions
Connected Locks: Intelligent Security at Your FingertipsTo complement physical security measures, intelligent data-driven solutions like connected locks are becoming essential. These systems offer remote monitoring and control, ideal for organizations with multiple locations. Connected locking solutions provide an end-to-end software platform linked to locking hardware, enhancing security for safes and strongroom doors. Users can manage access, receive real-time notifications, and monitor status remotely via smartphone apps, adding an extra layer of convenience and security.
Biometric Locks: Precision and Personalized Security
Biometric access systems are transforming high-security safes into smart solutions with advanced biometric access control. Features like Live Finger Detection (LFD) prevent unauthorized access by detecting counterfeit fingerprints. These systems offer dual-layer security with tamper alerts, duress alarms, and battery backups for power disruptions. They can also integrate with alarm systems and fogging mechanisms for heightened security during attacks.
In today’s digital-centric world, where cybersecurity often takes precedence, the importance of physical security solutions remains undeniable. Industries such as corporate offices, banking, retail, and jewellery are increasingly adopting advanced security measures, including safes, vaults, and strong room doors with intelligent locks, to tackle emerging challenges. As the physical security market continues to grow—driven by technological advancements and demanding security needs—organizations must embrace a comprehensive security ecosystem that seamlessly integrates both physical and digital innovations.(Authored Article)
Anirban Mukhuti- Head - Marketing and Product Management, Asia

Gunnebo Group offers safe storage, entrance control, and integrated security solutions to customers cutting across banking, retail, mass transit, public and commercial buildings, and industrial sites. Gunnebo Brands like Steelage and Chubbsafes have a rich legacy and presence of over 100 years in the physical security solutions category in the Indian subcontinent.
